valid_owner_sig_observed.meaning: a valid on-chain ECDSA owner signature is observable after an executed UserOp

high_s_counterpart_derived.meaning: an observer can derive a high-s counterpart (s' = curve_order - s, v' = v XOR 1) recovering the identical signer address from the valid owner signature

high_s_invalid_signature_s.meaning: the high-s signature causes OpenZeppelin ECDSA.tryRecover to return RecoverError.InvalidSignatureS

sig_validation_returns_failed_no_revert.meaning: signature validation returns SIG_VALIDATION_FAILED without reverting on the high-s signature mismatch, so the bundle is not reverted by this validation
sig_validation_returns_failed_no_revert.checkpoint: during AtomWallet.validateUserOp for the griefing UserOp

wallet_serviced_by_bundlers.meaning: bundlers continue to service the targeted AtomWallet so the user can submit transactions (negation of deprioritization/refusal degradation)

claims.scope: ERC-4337 UserOp signature validation in AtomWallet._validateSignature

preconditions.text: A valid on-chain ECDSA signature from an AtomWallet owner is observable after any executed UserOp.; From a valid owner signature an observer can derive a high-s counterpart with s' = curve_order - s and v' = v XOR 1, recovering the identical signer address.; A high-s signature causes OpenZeppelin ECDSA.tryRecover to return RecoverError.InvalidSignatureS.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: Signature validation should return SIG_VALIDATION_FAILED without reverting on signature mismatch, including high-s signatures, so a single invalid signature cannot revert the whole bundle.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: Persistent griefing can cause bundlers to deprioritize or refuse to service the targeted AtomWallet, degrading the user's ability to submit transactions.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The EntryPoint calls AtomWallet.validateUserOp during handleOps without a try/catch, so a revert in validation propagates to the bundle.
The griefing UserOp carries the derived high-s signature and targets an AtomWallet.
Impacts are described as potential; the plan formalizes the reported degradation relation, not an observed on-chain incident.

limitations: The degradation impact is qualitative and conditional on bundler implementation (retry/blacklist behavior is not asserted).
The plan formalizes only the wallet_degradation impact; bundle revert gas loss and bundler compute waste are separate impacts not covered here.
The exact 65-byte high-s signature byte-format check in the wallet is not detailed in the report.
